rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a projected slide points at a referent the room never saw. Closest: chunk 4 "Mitigate one risk" line 73 "If the option does not fit" (option = the mitigation shape the agent picks, named in the prompt and line 69 'The agent picks and applies the mitigation'); chunk 6 line 89 "We did this for one risk" (this = the mitigation loop, resolved by 'for one risk'). 'The check' (line 15) resolves to line 13 'your Exercise 1 security check'. Session-artifact carve-out covers the reports. Line 61 'The uncomfortable feeling' is filed under rule 16, not here.

Harm: callback by position dies depending on where the deck starts. Closest: line 7 "Your Exercise 1 skill is available in this project" and line 27 "go back to Exercise 1": points at the sibling exercise by number, but it is unpacked in line 13 as 'your Exercise 1 security check' and is a navigational pointer to a document the student holds. Line 101 names the Cookbook by title. No 'the opening lecture' style callback.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: reference to a beat that does not exist. Closest: line 101 "This was **Recipe 4**" resolves to 'R4, Scope an agent your organisation can trust' (cookbook line 51); 'four agent-risk patterns' matches the four listed in prompt audit-your-agent-2; 'the raw report from `module-4/policies/`' (line 35) matches 'outputs/policy-report-raw.md' in prompt 1; 'Exercise 1' skill exists as author-security-skill.md, listed first in security.md.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: reveal before guess, or a beat with no scene under a muted read. No guess-before-reveal beat exists. Muted read: line 9 "Name it `m4-agent-audit` if supported." and line 15 "Bring the policy raw report (baseline), the check (expert), your Module 3 system (target)." are verbed and referent-complete; closest: line 45 "Expect the reusable check to find things you did not think about" is a forecast, not a guess-cue aimed at the screen.

Harm: slide that says nothing standalone. Smallest chunk 6 "Separate prototype from production" line 89: "A production agent has a check or a closed door wherever its actions cannot be undone, and only a light check where redo is cheap." carries a self-contained claim.

Harm: header that the body contradicts. Closest: chunk 6 header 'Separate prototype from production' vs body line 89, which states what a production agent has that a prototype lacks; chunk 5 'Escalate to a person when judgment runs out' vs line 81 conditions for escalating. No contradiction.

Harm: a tic is the whole slide. Closest: line 99 "Certainty is not on offer. The discipline is the loop:" is a Not-X-Y pair, no third 'Not Z' leg; line 75 "The risk remains. That is expected. Name it, accept it on record, and stop there." three short sentences, third carries new concrete instruction; line 59/75 'That is expected.' recurs across two chunks, not within one. No superlatives, no number+retraction, no empty verb leg.

'lens' and 'loop' are earned training vocabulary (line 13 defines the loop), not maintainer dialect; closest: line 23 'which of its two lenses'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: bold monoculture. Closest: chunk 7 lines 93, 97, 101 carry three bolds ('What happened:', 'The point:', 'Recipe 4'); the first two are the exercise recap labels shared by 19 exercise files (sibling test), the third is a 2-word named handle. Chunk 5 line 79 '**Still not sure? Ask a person.**' is 6 words, a lead-in not a sentence of content. No whole bolded lead sentences.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: heading grammar flattened so a declaration cannot land. Exercise headings: 'Phase 1: Load the reusable check' .. 'Phase 4: Mitigate one risk, reassess the residual' (phase labels), 'Escalate to a person when judgment runs out', 'Separate prototype from production', 'Take stock of the loop you ran' (imperatives). No declarative heading in an exercise; no claim owed on a label.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "Run the agent-risk audit": line 61: "The uncomfortable feeling is the evidence." Class (c) aphorism kicker closing the slide; adds no move, object, tell or priority (line 59 already closes the topic), and its referent 'the uncomfortable feeling' is named nowhere in the file. No maintainer keep-note: the 2026-04-25 maintainer note says it 'reads as a slogan when projected silently to 12 SVPs; consider ... cutting on next polish'. Harm (slogan with no content on a wall) is present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a retitled slide keeps old-job bullets. git diff 4d9c4af2..HEAD shows every '##' line unchanged (only bodies edited, all trimmed or reworded under the same headers); closest: chunk 6 header 'Separate prototype from production' was kept while its body was rewritten to the control-where-undoable claim, which matches the header's job.
